description: The PATIENTS table contains demographic information for all patients in the database. This table includes patient identifiers, gender, date of birth, and date of death (if applicable), as well as an expiration flag. The primary key is a composite key of `ROW_ID` and `SUBJECT_ID`.

columns.name: ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each row in the table.

columns.name: SUBJECT_ID
columns.description: The patient identifier.

columns.name: GENDER
columns.description: The gender of the patient, 'F' for female and 'M' for male.

columns.name: DOB
columns.description: The date of birth of the patient.

columns.name: DOD
columns.description: The date of death of the patient, if applicable.

columns.name: DOD_HOSP
columns.description: Date of death recorded in the hospital, if applicable.

columns.name: DOD_SSN
columns.description: Date of death recorded by the Social Security number, if applicable.

columns.name: EXPIRE_FLAG
columns.description: A flag indicating whether the patient entry has expired or not, represented as 0 or 1.

description: The ADMISSIONS table contains information about hospital admissions for patients. It includes patient demographics, admission and discharge times, admission types and locations, insurance details, diagnoses, and mortality flags. This table serves as a central record for each hospital stay, linking patients to their admission details and outcomes.

columns.name: ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each row in the table.

columns.name: SUBJECT_ID
columns.description: The patient's unique identifier.

columns.name: HADM_ID
columns.description: The patient's hospital admission unique identifier.

columns.name: ADMITTIME
columns.description: The date and time the patient was admitted to the hospital.

columns.name: DISCHTIME
columns.description: The date and time the patient was discharged from the hospital.

columns.name: DEATHTIME
columns.description: The date and time of the patient's death, if it occurred during the hospital stay. Null if the patient did not die during the admission.

columns.name: ADMISSION_TYPE
columns.description: The type of admission (e.g., URGENT, ELECTIVE, EMERGENCY).

columns.name: ADMISSION_LOCATION
columns.description: The location from which the patient was admitted to the hospital.

columns.name: DISCHARGE_LOCATION
columns.description: The location to which the patient was discharged after their hospital stay.

columns.name: INSURANCE
columns.description: The type of insurance the patient has.

columns.name: LANGUAGE
columns.description: The primary language of the patient. Uses an abbreviated code.

columns.name: RELIGION
columns.description: The patient's religious affiliation.

columns.name: MARITAL_STATUS
columns.description: The patient's marital status.

columns.name: ETHNICITY
columns.description: The patient's self-identified ethnicity.

columns.name: EDREGTIME
columns.description: The date and time the patient was registered in the emergency department (ED).

columns.name: EDOUTTIME
columns.description: The date and time the patient left the emergency department (ED).

columns.name: DIAGNOSIS
columns.description: The diagnosis given for the patient's admission to the hospital. This is often a free-text field.

columns.name: HOSPITAL_EXPIRE_FLAG
columns.description: A binary flag indicating whether the patient expired (died) during the hospital admission. 1 indicates the patient died, 0 indicates they survived to discharge.

columns.name: HAS_CHARTEVENTS_DATA
columns.description: A binary flag indicating whether the patient has data in the CHARTEVENTS table. 1 indicates the patient has CHARTEVENTS data, 0 indicates they do not.

relationships.reason: SUBJECT_ID in ADMISSIONS likely references SUBJECT_ID in PATIENTS to identify the patient associated with the admission.
